stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

message.content:
Below is a **complete, end‑to‑end reference implementation** for a modern Trucking Transportation Management System (TMS).  
It is intentionally modular so you can drop‑in replace parts, scale horizontally, or swap out the database / cloud provider.

> **TL;DR** –  
> *Language*: Python 3.11 (FastAPI + SQLAlchemy)  
> *Database*: PostgreSQL (Docker‑Compose ready)  
> *Real‑time*: WebSocket + Redis Pub/Sub  
> *Route Optimisation*: Google OR‑Tools (linear‑programming)  
> *Front‑end*: React + Vite (optional – only API is shown)  
> *Testing*: PyTest + HTTPX  
> *CI/CD*: GitHub Actions (Docker image build & push)

---

## 1. Project Layout

```
tms/
├─ app/
│  ├─ main.py                # FastAPI entry point
│  ├─ config.py              # Settings (pydantic)
│  ├─ db/
│  │  ├─ models.py           # ORM models
│  │  ├─ crud.py             # CRUD helpers
│  │  └─ session.py          # DB session factory
│  ├─ schemas/
│  │  ├─ driver.py
│  │  ├─ shipment.py
│  │  ├─ vehicle.py
│  │  └─ ...                 # Pydantic DTOs
│  ├─ routers/
│  │  ├─ driver.py
│  │  ├─ shipment.py
│  │  ├─ vehicle.py
│  │  ├─ route.py
│  │  └─ billing.py
│  ├─ services/
│  │  ├─ routing.py          # OR‑Tools wrapper
│  │  ├─ tracking.py         # WebSocket + Redis
│  │  └─ billing.py
│  ├─ utils/
│  │  ├─ logger.py
│  │  └─ ...                 # helpers
│  └─ tests/
│     ├─ conftest.py
│     ├─ test_driver.py
│     ├─ test_shipment.py
│     └─ ...
├─ docker-compose.yml
├─ Dockerfile
├─ requirements.txt
└─ README.md
```

## 2. Core Domain Models (`app/db/models.py`)

```python
from sqlalchemy import (
    Column, Integer, String, Float, Boolean,
    ForeignKey, DateTime, Enum, JSON
)
from sqlalchemy.orm import relationship
from sqlalchemy.sql import func
from .session import Base
import enum

class DriverStatus(enum.Enum):
    ACTIVE = "active"
    INACTIVE = "inactive"
    ON_LEAVE = "on_leave"

class VehicleType(enum.Enum):
    TRUCK = "truck"
    RIGID = "rigid"
    TRAILER = "trailer"

class Driver(Base):
    __tablename__ = "drivers"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    name = Column(String(128), nullable=False)
    license_number = Column(String(64), unique=True, nullable=False)
    status = Column(Enum(DriverStatus), default=DriverStatus.ACTIVE)
    phone = Column(String(32))
    email = Column(String(128))
    created_at = Column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now())

    # relationships
    shipments = relationship("Shipment", back_populates="driver")

class Vehicle(Base):
    __tablename__ = "vehicles"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    vin = Column(String(64), unique=True, nullable=False)
    type = Column(Enum(VehicleType), nullable=False)
    capacity_tons = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    mileage_km = Column(Float, default=0.0)
    status = Column(Boolean, default=True)  # True = available
    last_service_date = Column(DateTime)

    # relationships
    shipments = relationship("Shipment", back_populates="vehicle")

class Shipment(Base):
    __tablename__ = "shipments"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    description = Column(String(256))
    pickup_lat = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    pickup_lon = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    delivery_lat = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    delivery_lon = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    weight_tons = Column(Float, nullable=False)
    status = Column(String(32), default="pending")  # pending, assigned, in_transit, delivered
    scheduled_start = Column(DateTime)
    scheduled_end = Column(DateTime)

    # FK
    driver_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("drivers.id"))
    vehicle_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("vehicles.id"))

    # relationships
    driver = relationship("Driver", back_populates="shipments")
    vehicle = relationship("Vehicle", back_populates="shipments")

class BillingRecord(Base):
    __tablename__ = "billing_records"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    shipment_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("shipments.id"))
    driver_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("drivers.id"))
    vehicle_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("vehicles.id"))
    distance_km = Column(Float)
    rate_per_km = Column(Float)
    total_amount = Column(Float)
    paid = Column(Boolean, default=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now())
```

## 6. CRUD Helpers (`app/db/crud.py`)

```python
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from .models import Driver, Vehicle, Shipment, BillingRecord
from .schemas.driver import DriverCreate, DriverUpdate
from .schemas.vehicle import VehicleCreate, VehicleUpdate
from .schemas.shipment import ShipmentCreate, ShipmentUpdate
from .schemas.billing import BillingCreate

def get_driver(db: Session, driver_id: int):
    return db.query(Driver).filter(Driver.id == driver_id).first()

def create_driver(db: Session, driver_in: DriverCreate):
    db_driver = Driver(**driver_in.dict())
    db.add(db_driver)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(db_driver)
    return db_driver

def update_driver(db: Session, db_driver: Driver, updates: DriverUpdate):
    for field, value in updates.dict(exclude_unset=True).items():
        setattr(db_driver, field, value)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(db_driver)
    return db_driver

# ... similar for Vehicle, Shipment, Billing
```

## 7. FastAPI Routers

### 7.1 Driver Router (`app/routers/driver.py`)

```python
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from ..db.session import SessionLocal
from ..db.crud import get_driver, create_driver, update_driver
from ..schemas.driver import Driver, DriverCreate, DriverUpdate
from typing import List

router = APIRouter(prefix="/drivers", tags=["drivers"])

def get_db():
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

@router.post("/", response_model=Driver, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def create_new_driver(driver_in: DriverCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    return create_driver(db, driver_in)

@router.get("/{driver_id}", response_model=Driver)
def read_driver(driver_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    db_driver = get_driver(db, driver_id)
    if not db_driver:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Driver not found")
    return db_driver

@router.put("/{driver_id}", response_model=Driver)
def update_existing_driver(driver_id: int, updates: DriverUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    db_driver = get_driver(db, driver_id)
    if not db_driver:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Driver not found")
    return update_driver(db, db_driver, updates)

@router.get("/", response_model=List[Driver])
def list_drivers(skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    drivers = db.query(Driver).offset(skip).limit(limit).all()
    return drivers
```

### 7.3 Route Optimisation Router (`app/routers/route.py`)

```python
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from ..services.routing import optimize_route
from ..schemas.route import RouteRequest, RouteResponse
from typing import List

router = APIRouter(prefix="/routes", tags=["routes"])

@router.post("/", response_model=RouteResponse)
def compute_route(req: RouteRequest):
    try:
        result = optimize_route(req)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc))
    return result
```

`RouteRequest` contains a list of shipment IDs; `RouteResponse` returns an ordered list of waypoints + total distance.

## 8. Routing Service (`app/services/routing.py`)

```python
from typing import List
from ortools.constraint_solver import pywrapcp, routing_enums_pb2
from ..db.session import SessionLocal
from ..db.crud import get_shipment
from ..schemas.route import RouteRequest, RouteResponse, Waypoint
import math

def haversine(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    R = 6371.0  # km
    phi1, phi2 = math.radians(lat1), math.radians(lat2)
    dphi = math.radians(lat2 - lat1)
    dlambda = math.radians(lon2 - lon1)
    a = math.sin(dphi/2)**2 + math.cos(phi1)*math.cos(phi2)*math.sin(dlambda/2)**2
    return R * 2 * math.atan2(math.sqrt(a), math.sqrt(1-a))

def build_distance_matrix(locations: List[tuple]) -> List[List[int]]:
    size = len(locations)
    matrix = [[0]*size for _ in range(size)]
    for i in range(size):
        for j in range(i+1, size):
            dist = int(haversine(*locations[i], *locations[j]) * 1000)  # meters
            matrix[i][j] = matrix[j][i] = dist
    return matrix

def optimize_route(req: RouteRequest) -> RouteResponse:
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        shipments = [get_shipment(db, sid) for sid in req.shipment_ids]
        if None in shipments:
            raise ValueError("One or more shipment IDs invalid")
    finally:
        db.close()

    # Build list of waypoints: start at depot (assume 0,0) then pickups/deliveries
    waypoints = [(0.0, 0.0)]  # depot
    for sh in shipments:
        waypoints.append((sh.pickup_lat, sh.pickup_lon))
        waypoints.append((sh.delivery_lat, sh.delivery_lon))

    distance_matrix = build_distance_matrix(waypoints)

    # OR-Tools TSP
    tsp_size = len(waypoints)
    tsp_index = pywrapcp.RoutingIndexManager(tsp_size, 1, 0)
    routing = pywrapcp.RoutingModel(tsp_index)

    def distance_callback(from_idx, to_idx):
        from_node = tsp_index.IndexToNode(from_idx)
        to_node = tsp_index.IndexToNode(to_idx)
        return distance_matrix[from_node][to_node]

    transit_callback_index = routing.RegisterTransitCallback(distance_callback)
    routing.SetArcCostEvaluatorOfAllVehicles(transit_callback_index)

    search_parameters = pywrapcp.DefaultRoutingSearchParameters()
    search_parameters.first_solution_strategy = (
        routing_enums_pb2.FirstSolutionStrategy.PATH_CHEAPEST_ARC
    )

    solution = routing.SolveWithParameters(search_parameters)
    if not solution:
        raise RuntimeError("No solution found")

    # Build response
    route = []
    index = routing.Start(0)
    while not routing.IsEnd(index):
        node = tsp_index.IndexToNode(index)
        lat, lon = waypoints[node]
        route.append(Waypoint(latitude=lat, longitude=lon, waypoint_type="depot" if node==0 else "stop"))
        index = solution.Value(routing.NextVar(index))
    # add final depot
    route.append(Waypoint(latitude=0.0, longitude=0.0, waypoint_type="depot"))

    total_distance_km = sum(
        haversine(*waypoints[tsp_index.IndexToNode(solution.Value(routing.NextVar(idx)))] ,
                  *waypoints[tsp_index.IndexToNode(idx)]) for idx in range(tsp_size)
    ) / 1000

    return RouteResponse(route=route, total_distance_km=total_distance_km)
```

## 9. Real‑time Tracking Service (`app/services/tracking.py`)

```python
import json
import asyncio
import aioredis
from fastapi import WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect
from ..config import settings

redis = aioredis.from_url(settings.REDIS_URL, encoding="utf-8", decode_responses=True)

class ConnectionManager:
    def __init__(self):
        self.active_connections: dict[int, WebSocket] = {}

    async def connect(self, websocket: WebSocket, driver_id: int):
        await websocket.accept()
        self.active_connections[driver_id] = websocket

    def disconnect(self, driver_id: int):
        self.active_connections.pop(driver_id, None)

    async def broadcast(self, driver_id: int, data: dict):
        ws = self.active_connections.get(driver_id)
        if ws:
            await ws.send_json(data)

manager = ConnectionManager()

async def publish_location(driver_id: int, lat: float, lon: float):
    payload = json.dumps({"driver_id": driver_id, "lat": lat, "lon": lon})
    await redis.publish(f"driver:{driver_id}:location", payload)

async def subscribe_location(driver_id: int):
    pubsub = redis.pubsub()
    await pubsub.subscribe(f"driver:{driver_id}:location")
    async for message in pubsub.listen():
        if message["type"] == "message":
            data = json.loads(message["data"])
            await manager.broadcast(driver_id, data)
```

**WebSocket Endpoint** (`app/routers/tracking.py`)

```python
from fastapi import APIRouter, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect
from ..services.tracking import manager, subscribe_location

router = APIRouter(prefix="/tracking", tags=["tracking"])

@router.websocket("/ws/{driver_id}")
async def websocket_endpoint(websocket: WebSocket, driver_id: int):
    await manager.connect(websocket, driver_id)
    try:
        await subscribe_location(driver_id)
    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        manager.disconnect(driver_id)
```

## 10. Billing Service (`app/services/billing.py`)

```python
from datetime import datetime
from ..db.session import SessionLocal
from ..db.crud import get_shipment, get_driver, get_vehicle, create_billing_record
from ..schemas.billing import BillingCreate

def calculate_rate(distance_km: float, vehicle_type: str) -> float:
    base_rates = {"truck": 1.2, "rigid": 1.0, "trailer": 1.5}
    return base_rates.get(vehicle_type, 1.0) * 1.1  # surcharge

def generate_billing(shipment_id: int) -> dict:
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        shipment = get_shipment(db, shipment_id)
        if not shipment:
            raise ValueError("Shipment not found")
        driver = get_driver(db, shipment.driver_id)
        vehicle = get_vehicle(db, shipment.vehicle_id)
        distance_km = haversine(
            shipment.pickup_lat, shipment.pickup_lon,
            shipment.delivery_lat, shipment.delivery_lon
        )
        rate = calculate_rate(distance_km, vehicle.type.value)
        total = distance_km * rate

        billing_in = BillingCreate(
            shipment_id=shipment.id,
            driver_id=driver.id,
            vehicle_id=vehicle.id,
            distance_km=distance_km,
            rate_per_km=rate,
            total_amount=total,
            paid=False
        )
        record = create_billing_record(db, billing_in)
        return record
    finally:
        db.close()
```

**WebSocket Example**

```tsx
// src/Tracking.tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

export const Tracking = ({ driverId }: { driverId: number }) => {
  const [location, setLocation] = useState<{ lat: number; lon: number } | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const ws = new WebSocket(`ws://localhost:8000/tracking/ws/${driverId}`);
    ws.onmessage = (e) => {
      const data = JSON.parse(e.data);
      setLocation({ lat: data.lat, lon: data.lon });
    };
    return () => ws.close();
  }, [driverId]);

  return (
    <div>
      <h3>Live Location</h3>
      {location ? (
        <p>
          Lat: {location.lat.toFixed(4)}, Lon: {location.lon.toFixed(4)}
```
